code.title: Update URL injected into PowerShell script without escaping
code.finding: browser_download_url from the GitHub API was interpolated into a single-quoted PowerShell string without validation
code.consequence: A crafted API response could append commands to the update script
code.fix: Validate https://github.com host and reject quotes/newlines before interpolation

code.title: Download URLs passed to yt-dlp without option terminator
code.finding: URL was the last argument with no -- separator, so a leading dash was read as a yt-dlp option
code.consequence: A title starting with '-' could set yt-dlp flags such as --cookies or --exec
code.fix: Insert -- before the URL in every yt-dlp invocation

code.title: OAuth tokens and cookies written with world-readable permissions
code.finding: Session files were created at the process umask (0644 observed)
code.consequence: Any local user could read the YouTube session and Discord tokens
code.fix: umask 0077 at startup and explicit 0600 in the Python helper

dependency.title: Build dependencies pinned but years out of date
dependency.finding: All versions are pinned but date from 2023-2024
dependency.fix: Upgrade when the Android build can be re-verified end to end

security.title: Remote installer executed without integrity check enables RCE
security.finding: curl -fsSL <url> | bash piped the upstream script straight into a shell
security.fix: Download to temp, verify pinned SHA256, execute only on match

security.title: Android signing key and password shipped in the repository
security.finding: Signing keystore and its password were public, allowing anyone to sign APKs as the app
security.fix: Remove keystore from git, keep the same key in GitHub Secrets and local toolchain

security.title: Session cookies and OAuth tokens readable by other local users
security.finding: Credential files were written with 0644 permissions
security.fix: umask 0077 and chmod 0600 on credential files

security.title: Unescaped download URL and option-less yt-dlp invocation
security.finding: API-provided URL interpolated into PowerShell and download URL not separated with --
security.fix: Validate URL scheme/host and add -- terminator

security.title: Exported media service lets other apps control playback
security.finding: AudioService was exported with no permission although only in-app components use it

security.title: Protected WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission requested by the app
security.finding: A protected permission used only for an optional MIUI refresh-rate tweak was declared
security.fix: Drop the permission and the MIUI settings write

security.title: App data allowed in unencrypted backups
security.finding: allowBackup=true permits adb backup of app data including session state
